content: 1. Cefotaxime reduces the levels or effects of ethinyl estradiol by altering intestinal flora. This interaction applies only to oral forms of the hormone. The risk of contraceptive failure is low, but caution and close monitoring are advised. 2. Cefprozil decreases the levels or effects of ethinyl estradiol by modifying intestinal flora. This interaction is specific to oral hormonal forms. The risk of contraceptive failure is minimal, but careful monitoring is recommended. 3. Women should be advised to use additional or alternative non-hormonal birth control methods when using cenobamate with oral contraceptives. 7.
